target_customer: Indian retail options traders and day traders who want to backtest and automate strategies without coding
problem: Retail traders in India lacked institutional grade tools for options backtesting and execution. AlgoTest offers a free no-code backtester and a paid live execution engine.
business_model: Freemium SaaS subscription for backtesting and live algo execution

founders.name: Raghav Malik
prior_employers: Options market maker in New York (firm not named)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: began as an options market maker in New York then built low latency trading software for Indian HFT firms.

founders.name: Rajat Jaiswal
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by search summaries of the YC profile, StartupIntros and TheOrg; the YC page and launch post I opened name only Raghav Malik, so this is lightly sourced.

competitors.name: Streak (Zerodha ecosystem)
competitors.what: No-code strategy creation, backtesting and live deployment for Indian traders
competitors.traction_then: Established before the batch, integrated with the Zerodha ecosystem
competitors.funding_then: $1M pre-Series A led by 3one4 Capital, reported 2019, with Rainmatter participating

technical_complexity.rationale: Fast options backtesting over large historical data and reliable live order execution via broker APIs are demanding but standard for a founder with HFT experience.

defensibility.rationale: Historical options data and strategy libraries help, but backtesting tools were established (Streak) and broker APIs are open to all.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found. AlgoTest was still operating in 2026 and publishing on SEBI algo trading rules.

market_need_then: The YC launch post says retail tools cost a fraction of what institutions pay and claims AlgoTest is more powerful than existing retail tools. Indian retail options trading volumes were large, and Streak's earlier funding shows the category was backed.

identity.voice_and_tone: Educational and practical; large blog library on algo trading in India

branding.community_and_virality: Company claims a community of 35,000 plus traders (its own blog, unverified); heavy SEO content.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name that says what it does but is generic; growth appears driven by content and product rather than brand.

outcome_analysis: AlgoTest is a Delhi based options algo platform founded by a former US options market maker and Indian HFT technologist. It reports a community of 35,000 plus traders and a team of 40, and is still publishing and operating in 2026. Funding visible in aggregators is small (about $500K pre-seed in 2022), which suggests a capital efficient business, but revenue figures are unverified.
notes: Funding unverified: Inc42, Extruct, Caplight and Seedtable list about $500K pre-seed in August 2022 (Goodwater Capital, Belvedere, Y Combinator, Soma Capital), all aggregators; Latka says $0 raised and $6.9M revenue, a conflict. No round recorded. Founding year 2021 per YC page, while another profile says 2022. The company site fetch returned only a title. Completeness pass: recorded a 500K pre-seed in August 2022 reported by Inc42, Caplight and CB Insights (databases). One GEO profile says 750K and Latka says nothing raised, so the amount is unconfirmed by press.
